scope: Temporary diagnostic firmware; no PDB or ESC attached.
application_crc_test: One deliberately bad application CRC rejected; following valid echo passed.
connection_caveat: Capture review found an initial TCP reset from the board followed by another SYN and a completed handshake in 600 of 3,397 normal TCP cases. The repeated connection setup remains a reliability and timing limitation. These cases had a median of 509.9 ms from the first SYN to a successful handshake.
rate_definition: Counts include functional and soak checks. Each KiB/s value is one complete 1 MiB echo, including connection, host Python checks and logging, TCP window and acknowledgment timing, and half close; bytes are counted once. It is not an isolated CPU benchmark or Ethernet line rate.
clock_scope: CPU clock, SPI clock and Ethernet link rate are separate quantities. Independent SWD register decoding verified clock settings; W5500 status reported a 100 Mbps link in all nine profiles. Host timed DWT intervals are additional checks, not calibrated frequency measurements.
capture_excerpt: Selected TCP stream, UDP payload/CRC exchanges, and board-related ARP/ICMP packets across the full diagnostic session. This excerpt includes traffic outside the final nine-profile matrix. Excerpt frame numbers differ from original screenshot frame numbers.
